name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Write a detailed and engaging YouTube video script about {topic} with a {tone} tone, lasting about {length} minutes.
prompts.use_case: YouTubers seeking to automate video content generation and publishing

prompts.name: voiceover_configuration_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a natural-sounding voiceover in {language} using a {voice_type} voice at {speech_speed} speed for the provided script.
prompts.use_case: Content marketers creating scripted video content quickly without manual effort

prompts.name: video_creation_prompt
prompts.template: Combine the voiceover audio with relevant visuals and background effects to create a {resolution} resolution video suited for YouTube.
prompts.use_case: Businesses automating voiceover and video creation for promotional materials

prompts.name: upload_video_prompt
prompts.template: Upload the video titled '{video_title}' to the YouTube channel authenticated by the provided credentials with the description '{video_description}'.
prompts.use_case: Educational content creators generating tutorial videos from textual scripts
